newsitem.title: USA: Image Guided sees Q4 net over $125,000.
newsitem.headline: Image Guided sees Q4 net over $125,000.

text.p: Image Guided Technologies Inc Thursday said net income for the fourth quarter 1996 is expected to exceed $125,000, compared with a loss of $192,000 for the same period in l995.
For fiscal 1996, net income is expected to exceed $350,000 compared with a net loss of $1,052,000 for 1995, the company said.
The company said it anticipates fourth quarter 1996 revenue to be between $1.1 million and $1.2 million, up from fourth quarter 1995 revenue of $800,000.
Revenues for the fiscal year ended December 31 would be a record, between $4.0 million and $4.1 million, up from 1995 revenues of $1.9 million, it added.

"We are very pleased with our preliminary fourth quarter results. Factors contributing to this record performance include increased sales of FlashPoint and Pixsys accessories, and sales to prospective OEM customers," said Paul L. Ray, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

The company designs, develops, manufactures and markets precision-measurement products for systems used in image-guided surgery, a specialty procedure in the field of minimally-invasive, computer- assisted surgery.
Audited fiscal year results are expected to be released in the second week of March, the company said.
